readme: Golden examples for free-text workouts (R1): what a coach types and the workout it must become (structure v1, api/endpoints.md § Workout structure).

The web builder's quick text (frontend), the mock's POST /ai/workout and the backend's POST /ai/workout all parse with the same grammar (docs/workout-text.md) and must give exactly this: structure, name, warnings (pieces not understood, as typed) and tags (#hashtags). A missing warnings/tags means none.

Add an example: append {"text": "…", "sport": "run|swim|bike|strength|mobility|other"} (optionally "comment": why), run `node api/mock/workout-text-examples.mjs --fill` and review what it wrote. If it's wrong, correct the expected fields by hand: the check (npm run check:api, the frontend tests, the backend tests) then fails until the three parsers are fixed to match.
Show one parse without saving: node api/mock/workout-text-examples.mjs run "6x1km @4:30 c/ 2' trote".
